subject: Request: demo window support and temporary sandbox lift
messages:
From: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightside.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Kevin Li <kevin.li@brightside.ai>
Date: 2025-11-03T08:12:00-08:00
Subject: Demo reschedule & environment support request

Hi Jordan,

Quick note from our engineering lead — we hit a blocker while wiring up the payload adapter to your webhook endpoint and it looks like there are two separate issues: an SAML metadata mismatch on our SSO side and intermittent signature verifications failing in staging that cause the connector to drop messages under load. We are still confident we can demo, but we need a short runway to stabilize the integration.

Is there a way to temporarily lift the sandbox quota and extend the demo window? Our original demo is Nov 12; proposal is to push the customer demo to Nov 19 and get a temporary sandbox boost through Nov 30. If possible we’d also appreciate a small token credit to re-run our nightly ETL tests while we iterate. I attached a small integration log that shows the stack traces we’re seeing.

Attachment: integration-log.txt (text)

We want to avoid delaying the prospect any further — the execs are watching this opportunity. Please let me know the fastest path to get engineering support and whether Redwood can provide a short-term environment lift.

Thanks,
Samantha Ortiz
Director of Product
Brightside AI
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightside.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T09:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo reschedule & environment support request

Thanks for the details, Samantha — sorry you hit this. I’ve looped in Marissa from CS so we can coordinate the schedule and the sandbox adjustments. We can absolutely help: I’m going to escalate to engineering to get a quick triage and we can provision a temporary increase to your sandbox and apply a testing credit while we work through the signature/SAML issues.

Before I escalate to infra, two quick asks:
- Can you confirm the new preferred demo date (Nov 19) and any hard constraints?
- Can you share a sanitized SAML metadata snippet or the exact error string for the failure modes?

I’ll propose a 40k-token credit for nightly tests and a sandbox extension through Nov 30 while we triage. If engineering believes more tokens are required we’ll revisit. Marissa — are you ok to mark this as a priority and push the necessary quota change?

Attached: PoC-schedule.pdf (proposed updated dates)

— Jordan
Principal SDR, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T10:20:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Demo reschedule & environment support request

Forwarding Brightside details — see integration-log.txt attached. They’ve asked to move the demo to Nov 19 and need a temporary sandbox quota lift to Nov 30 plus a token credit to re-run nightly ETL. Deal: BRI-2025-041.

Can you please evaluate below and reply with: 1) ETA to root cause for the signature/SAML failures, 2) whether a short VPC tunnel or temporary allowlist would unblock them faster, and 3) feasibility of applying a 40k token credit immediately (we can bill later if needed).

> 
> Quick note from our engineering lead — we hit a blocker while wiring up the payload adapter to your webhook endpoint and it looks like there are two separate issues: an SAML metadata mismatch on our SSO side and intermittent signature verifications failing in staging that cause the connector to drop messages under load. We are still confident we can demo, but we need a short runway to stabilize the integration.

— Jordan
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-03T16:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Demo reschedule & environment support request

Quick tech read: the errors in the log look like two separate failure modes — a metadata mismatch (likely config mismatch on the SP side) and a sporadic HMAC verification fail under load caused by queue reordering in staging. We can remediate both:

- SAML: 1 business day to confirm metadata and push corrected SP metadata, assuming they provide the snippet.
- HMAC/signature: staging has a burst that reorders events; adding a short-lived queuing buffer and applying idempotency keys reduces the fail rate. Estimate 3 business days to implement and test.

Workarounds that would speed the demo:
- Provide a short-lived allowlist for Brightside staging IPs or open a tunneled SSH reverse proxy to their staging host so we bypass the staging queuing edge (low risk for 7–10 days).
- Apply a one-time test credit of 40,000 tokens so they can run the nightly ETL while we patch.

I recommend we approve the sandbox lift + 40k token credit and offer an engineer on standby for the Nov 19 demo — lower risk than expanding credits further. If the customer insists on a higher load test, we can re-assess after the patch.

— Dev
Staff Software Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@brightside.ai>, Kevin Li <kevin.li@brightside.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-11-05T15:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Demo reschedule & environment support request — Approved

Hi Samantha / Kevin,

Good news — we reviewed the ask and can support the adjusted timeline. Summary of what we’re approving:

- Demo move to Nov 19 confirmed per your preference.
- Temporary sandbox lift through 2025-11-30 to allow broader staging runs.
- One-time test credit: 40,000 tokens applied to account BRI-2025-041 (visible in the console).
- Dev Patel will be on standby the week of Nov 17 for triage and the demo.

Marissa will apply the quota change and the credit now; you should see the tokens in your dashboard within 30 minutes. Please attach the sanitized SAML metadata or the exact error string for the SAML failure to this thread so Dev can validate tomorrow. If you’d like a short-lived proxy/allowlist while we patch, we can set that up as well — let us know which you prefer.

Attachments: PoC-schedule.pdf (updated), integration-log.txt

Next steps:
1) Samantha: confirm Nov 19 demo slot and send SAML snippet.
2) Brightside: run nightly ETL once credit shows and report any residual failures.
3) Redwood: engineer standby and create temporary allowlist if requested.

We’ll keep this tight — appreciate the clear signals and patience. Looking forward to the demo.

— Jordan Blake
Principal SDR, Redwood Inference
